name: XLA_SLAM_JE_RULE_SETS_
description: This table contains the journal entry rule set assignment to accounting methods.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_METHOD_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether the accounting method is seeded or not.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Short name of the method used to record the financial impact of Subledger transactions, such as accrual basis, cash basis, or combined basis accounting.

columns.name: JERS_ASSIGNMENT_ID
columns.description: Assignment identifier of the journal rule set.

columns.name: AMB_CONTEXT_CODE
columns.description: Accounting methods builder context.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Functional area within a software suite of products. For example, Financials or Payroll.

columns.name: JOURNAL_RULE_SET_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether the journal entry rule set is seeded or not.

columns.name: JOURNAL_RULE_SET_CODE
columns.description: Unique abbreviated name assigned to a journal entry rule set and used for reporting or in reference to an option.

columns.name: EVENT_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Unique abbreviated name assigned to an event class and used for reporting or in reference to an option.

columns.name: EVENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Unique abbreviated name assigned to an event type and used for reporting or in reference to an option.

columns.name: START_DATE_ACTIVE
columns.description: Active start date of the journal entry rule set assignment.

columns.name: END_DATE_ACTIVE
columns.description: Active end date of the journal entry rule set assignment.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: EXCLUDE_ACCOUNTING_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the journal entry rule set assignment should be excluded from accounting.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.

columns.name: AUDIT_IMPERSONATOR_
columns.description: Original Impersonator User.
